title: Stop the Operator Station using the CYCLE STOP button on the Operator Station Main Screen
summary: An operator can stop the operator station by pressing the CYCLE STOP button on the operator station main screen.
when_to_use: Use when you need to stop the operator station cycle from the operator station main screen by pressing the CYCLE STOP control.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the operator station main screen and press CYCLE STOP to stop the tipping/operation cycle.

visual_references.description: Operator station main screen showing the CYCLE STOP button (used for stopping the operator station).

steps.title: Open the Operator Station Main Screen
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that contains the CYCLE STOP control for stopping the operator station.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the operator station main screen.
steps.expected_result: The operator station main screen is displayed and the CYCLE STOP control is available for use.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the CYCLE STOP button on the operator station main screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the CYCLE STOP button or are not on the operator station main screen.

actions.label: Navigate to operator station main screen
actions.exact_action: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the operator station main screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.4: STOPPING THE OPERATOR STATION 1. Press CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen.

steps.title: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the operator station
steps.purpose: Stop the operator station cycle using the documented CYCLE STOP control.
steps.instruction: Press the CYCLE STOP button on the operator station main screen.
steps.expected_result: The operator station stops after pressing CYCLE STOP.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing CYCLE STOP, the operator station no longer runs the cycle.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing CYCLE STOP does not stop the operator station cycle.

actions.label: Press CYCLE STOP
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing CYCLE STOP does not stop the operator station, stop further operation and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.4: STOPPING THE OPERATOR STATION 1. Press CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen.

steps.title: Verify the operator station is stopped
steps.purpose: Confirm the stop action took effect.
steps.instruction: Observe the operator station after pressing CYCLE STOP to confirm it is stopped.
steps.expected_result: The operator station is stopped (the cycle is no longer running after pressing CYCLE STOP).
steps.healthy_condition: The cycle does not continue running after CYCLE STOP is pressed.
steps.failure_condition: The cycle continues running after CYCLE STOP is pressed.

actions.label: Observe cycle behavior
actions.exact_action: Observe that the operator station is stopped (stop action is evidenced by the system no longer running the cycle after pressing CYCLE STOP).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station does not stop, stop further operation and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 5.4: STOPPING THE OPERATOR STATION 1. Press CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen.

success_criteria: After pressing CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen, the operator station stops and the cycle no longer runs.
healthy_conditions: CYCLE STOP is visible on the operator station main screen.
After pressing CYCLE STOP, the operator station cycle does not continue running.
failure_conditions: CYCLE STOP does not stop the operator station cycle.
escalation_guidance: If pressing CYCLE STOP does not stop the operator station, stop further operation and escalate to support.
